subject: Copywriting
title: Ann Handley: Everybody Writes
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Ann Handley: Everybody Writes.

hook.text: Ann Handley declared that in the digital age, everybody writes—and those who write well will rule business.

buildup.text: Her book 'Everybody Writes' became a bible for content marketers who needed to produce quality copy daily.

discovery.text: Handley's insight: web copy isn't advertising. It's a service. Useful content builds trust that ads never could.

twist.text: She proved that B2B companies, considered 'boring,' could build massive audiences just by writing useful content.

climax.text: Handley helped shift copywriting from persuasion-first to value-first. The paradigm became: help, then sell.

punchline.text: Everybody writes now. The best writers win the audience.

quiz.question: What paradigm shift did Handley promote?
